def test_DIGEST_AUTH_SETS_SESSION_COOKIES(self, httpbin):
        for authtype in self.digest_auth_algo:
            url = httpbin("digest-auth", "auth", "user", "pass", authtype)
            auth = HTTPDigestAuth("user", "pass")
            s = requests.Session()
            s.get(url, auth=auth)
            assert s.cookies["fake"] == "fake_value"
